name: How early should finish selections be made in a luxury build?

mainEntity.name: When do I need to choose cabinets, tile, fixtures, and other finishes?
mainEntity.text: When do I need to choose cabinets, tile, fixtures, and other finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish selections should be made much earlier than most homeowners expect. In a luxury custom home, cabinetry, tile, plumbing fixtures, lighting, countertops, flooring, and specialty hardware often influence the schedule and the budget. Some items must be selected before rough-in, while others should be locked before fabrication or ordering begins. If selections are delayed, the builder may have to pause work, reorder items, or revise installed work to fit the new choice. The smartest approach is to prioritize long-lead and coordination-heavy items first, then work through the remaining finishes in sequence. A good builder should provide a selection calendar so decisions happen before they become schedule problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish selections should start early enough to support pricing, lead times, and coordination with framing and rough-in work. Waiting too long can cause delays, substitutions, and change orders later in the project.
